name: luma-harness
description: Configurable multi-agent work harness with desktop and mobile clients

scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/desktop run build && npm --prefix apps/mobile run build
scripts.test: node --test scripts/public-runtime.test.cjs && npm --prefix services/gateway test && npm --prefix apps/desktop test && npm run test:harness && npm run test:pi && npm run test:workflow
scripts.test:pi: npm --prefix apps/desktop/connectors/pi test && node --test apps/desktop/electron/piBridge.test.cjs && node apps/desktop/electron/testOrder72MjsArtifact.cjs && node apps/desktop/electron/testOrder76UserAcceptanceHandoff.cjs && node apps/desktop/electron/testOrder78HandoffConvergence.cjs
